svg.title: fal in Microsoft Foundry: fast draft or final render?
svg.desc: Source-based model comparison, not generated video. LTX Fast and Pro share 720p settings with six-second illustrative cost estimates of 54 and 72 cents. MiniMax H3 Max Turbo and Max share 480p settings with five-second estimates of 12.5 and 25 cents. Kling Pro offers native audio and directed motion. Live generation is blocked because Fal.EnableDeploy is NotRegistered. Launch price units require confirmation.

g.text: THE HANDOFF / NOV 9, 2026
Fast draft or final render?
Choose for the next decision, not for the biggest model name.
SOURCE-BASED COMPARISON / NO GENERATED SAMPLES / PUBLIC PREVIEW
LTX-2.5 / synchronized audio
Same settings: 720p, 24 fps, 6 seconds
FAST
PRO
Fast: rapid iteration and previews
Pro: evaluate high-fidelity final output
MiniMax H3 / post-trained variants
Same settings: 480P, 5 seconds; measure actual fps
TURBO
MAX
Turbo: lower listed cost; evaluate turnaround
Max: adds image, video, and audio references
Kling v3 Pro / directed motion + native audio
US Data Zone / 3-15 s / 5 s with audio off: $0.616* / resolution and fps: measure output
Before a live attempt: access + offering/region + quota + cost + terms
Here: Fal.EnableDeploy = NotRegistered. No requests, resources, clips, or measured timings.
*Illustrative requested-duration cost using the launch table's USD/video-second heading.
Its prose says per minute: confirm the unit in the deployment UI. These are not invoices.
Sources: Microsoft announcement (Nov 5) + Microsoft Learn fal preview guide. Retrieved Nov 9, 2026.
Bars compare cost within each family only. No measured speed ranking or quality result is claimed.
